notes: Inventory lookup uses C get_obj_in_list_vis (keyword prefix via getObjInInvVis), not Inventory.FindItem which also matched the short description / interior substring. A short-desc-only arg ("of", "water" on a stripped-keyword skin) must miss.
Not carried (non-werewolf) yields "You don't seem to have a/an X.".
A non-food below god yields "You can't eat THAT!".
taste on a drinkcon/fountain delegates to do_drink SCMD_SIP.
taste emits "You nibble a little bit of $p." and "$n tastes a little bit of $p.".
eat emits "You eat $p." and "$n eats $p." and gains FULL.
FULL>40 yields "You are too full to eat more!".
Poisoned food below immort yields "Oops, that tasted rather strange!" and applies poison.
